title: TradeLocker Module Guide
heading: Trading — TradeLocker
intro: This module is a broker. With it installed, every trading endpoint — /api/v1/orders, /positions, /balance, /instruments, /market/candles — acts on your TradeLocker account whenever a TradeLocker account is the active one. The API you call does not change; only which broker answers it.

You connect with your own TradeLocker email, password and server. The password is used once to obtain JWT tokens and is never stored. You may hold several logins at once — a demo and a live one — and every account under each becomes selectable.

sections.title: Your TradeLocker logins
sections.sub: Each login and the server it authenticates against. Connect and disconnect from the Accounts page.
sections.empty: No TradeLocker login connected yet — use Add account.

endpoints.title: Connected logins
endpoints.desc: Every TradeLocker login on this account, with its server and environment. Session-authenticated (a bearer token), not an API key — connecting a broker is an account action, not a data read.

endpoints.title: Accounts across every broker
endpoints.desc: Core's own endpoint, not this module's — it asks each installed broker for its accounts and files the answer under the broker's id. With this module installed you get a `tradelocker` key carrying your logins and the accounts under each.

notes: Everything the app can do against Exness it can do here. The adapter subclasses the shared broker spine, so the SL/TP calculators, position sizing, break-even, lock-profit and bulk operations are the same code, not a second implementation.
The developer key in Admin → Settings is optional. TradeLocker authenticates with YOUR credentials; the partner key only raises a rate limit, so a self-hosted instance works without one.
Which broker a call goes to is decided by the ACTIVE account, not by the endpoint. Switch the active account on the Accounts page and the whole app follows it.
